description: This file defines a PHP class OAMClient for interacting with the CloudWatch Observability Access Manager service via AWS SDK. It includes method annotations for various API operations related to links and sinks, including synchronous and asynchronous methods.

classes.name: Aws\OAM\OAMClient
classes.description: A client class for interfacing with the AWS CloudWatch Observability Access Manager service, inheriting functionality from AwsClient.

methods.name: createLink
methods.description: Creates a new link in the CloudWatch Observability Access Manager service.

methods.name: createLinkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously creates a new link, returning a promise.

methods.name: createSink
methods.description: Creates a new sink in the service.

methods.name: createSinkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version for creating a sink.

methods.name: deleteSinkAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version for deleting a sink.

methods.name: getLink
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific link.

methods.name: getSink
methods.description: Retrieves details about a specific sink.

methods.name: getSinkPolicy
methods.description: Retrieves the policy of a sink.

methods.name: listAttachedLinks
methods.description: Lists links attached to a resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResource
methods.description: Lists tags for a given resource.

methods.name: listTagsForResourceAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous list of tags for a resource.

methods.name: putSinkPolicy
methods.description: Sets the policy for a sink.
